name: melann-lending-system-v2
description: Modernized Melann Lending System V2 – React + Node.js + SQLite

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.audit:prod: npm audit --omit=dev --prefix server && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix client
scripts.audit:all: npm audit --prefix server && npm audit --prefix client
scripts.verify:release: npm run audit:prod && npm test --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client && npm test --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: start "Melann Server" cmd /k "cd server && npm run dev" && start "Melann Client" cmd /k "cd client && npm run dev"
